DDM iframe demo page

This page embeds two same-origin iframes so you can exercise cdp_list_frames → ddm_frame → js_eval_frame. Open it with file:// or serve it locally.

Payment form (simulated Stripe-style iframe)

Login widget (simulated OAuth iframe)

Expected DDM output on this page: two X blocks in the grid, hints showing Iframe: iframe_payment.html and Iframe: iframe_login.html.
After cdp_list_frames: frame 0 = payment, frame 1 = login.
After ddm_frame("0"): card number + expiry + CVC inputs visible.
